text:
Introduction
Safety Precautions
A work 
 permit must be issued and the qualified maintenance staff should carry the 
 suitable safety category.
Safety fence 
 with caution marks surrounding the work area is required.
Wear standard personal safety and healthy equipment as safety helmet, safety shoes,
 hearing protection, rubber, gloves ... etc.
Selector switch must be in test position
Tools and Equipment
Test equipment level "dip sticks", multimeter, common sets keys,
 cleaning material "rags, cloth" and screw driver set
Work to be carried out
In addition to the daily inspection
steps do the following:
Change the operation position from automatic to local
 control.
Check the hydraulic governor oil level.
Check the coolant system coolant level.
Check for air cleaner restriction.
Check the fuel level, ensure it is at least 1/2 full.
Check the battery charging system including water level in
 batteries
Start the unit up and run it at rated RPM and Check
 for unusual vibration.
Check start switch in automatic.
Perform operation load test by switching on main CB
Make overall visual inspection.
Change the operation position from local to automatic.
